raw_source.text_snippet:
Between 1999 and 2014, BRCA1/2 testing was performed using conformation-sensitive gel electrophoresis (CSGE) or conformation-sensitive capillary electrophoresis (CSCE), followed by Sanger sequencing. The Portuguese BRCA2 founder variant was screened using a specific polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based assay, and large deletions and insertions in BRCA1 and BRCA2 were assessed by multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification (MRC Holland, Amsterdam, Netherlands).

From 2014 to 2018, next-generation sequencing (NGS) was performed using either the TruSight Cancer Sequencing Panel by Illumina ... All pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants identified by NGS were confirmed by Sanger sequencing, while multiplex ligation-dependent probe amplification was used to detect CNVs and the Portuguese founder variant in BRCA2 .

Since 2018, hereditary breast and ovarian cancer testing has been performed exclusively using multigene panels ... enabling the integrated detection of SNVs, CNVs, and the BRCA2 founder variant.
